checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan Muse MVP: provider protocol + Replicate adapter, Gemini audio judge, crash-safe artifacts, CLI/library, offline tests

impact_assessment.why: Projects need original themed music plus an automated listener that proves the track fits before shipping
impact_assessment.benefits: One command returns audio and a scored verdict; adapters are swappable and the whole suite runs without keys or network
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CLI and Python API; dependency: Replicate and Gemini over stdlib urllib only; concurrency: none; state: artifacts under output/, secrets stay in env
impact_assessment.mitigation: Protocol boundaries with mock adapters, schema-checked judge replies, atomic metadata writes, failing-first unit tests

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Implemented Muse MVP: 57 offline tests, 4/4 gates, offline generate+judge dogfood passes; checklists: passed

handoff.next: set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN and GEMINI_API_KEY, run one live generation for a real project theme

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Harden Muse after review: input validation, atomic downloads, judge payload limits, evidence on judge failure, ADRs

impact_assessment.why: A first implementation passed tests but could still traceback on bad input, upload an oversized judge payload, and leave partial downloads or empty folders
impact_assessment.benefits: Every failure is a 1/2 exit with What/Why/Fix; downloads never leave corrupt audio; judge evidence is preserved; architecture is recorded
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI exit codes and metadata on judge failure; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: output artifacts and ledger
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests per defect, atomic temp-and-replace, ADRs, full gate run before commit

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Review fixes implemented: 69 offline tests, 4/4 gates, strict and misuse dogfood; checklists: passed
[3/3] Review fixes implemented: 69 offline tests, 4/4 gates, staged secret scan clean; checklists: passed
